rounds.proposer_claim: The package manifest plus role, response, receipt, and policy schemas form the smallest coherent hardening unit.
rounds.evidence_or_assumption: Without a common frozen manifest, owner and verifier evidence can bind different bytes; without separate role/receipt contracts, the manifest becomes an ambient permission.
rounds.candidate_split: separate schema files but one package identity

rounds.proposer_claim: Verification-level assignment and the superseding-package rule must remain inside the same unit.
rounds.evidence_or_assumption: A level outside the frozen package can be lowered or changed while reusing old receipts; the user's floor decision explicitly restarts verification after change.
rounds.candidate_split: defer checker implementation but retain its exact interface and policy boundary

smallest_coherent_unit.name: frozen role-scoped owner-admission package
smallest_coherent_unit.primary_responsibility: bind exactly who may decide which scope, what structural verification level is required, and which unchanged bytes every future response and receipt covers

responses without verification levels bypass risk floors
receipts without package digests can follow changed bytes

recomposition_proof: Start with the exact package manifest. Reproduce each bound raw-file digest, the package-content digest, and the manifest self-digest using the three declared const methods. Resolve each OAR slice to its separately scoped Rondelli role assignment and owner-response contract. Resolve its assigned level to either the exact accepted Victor-owned V1 policy/checker boundary or direct Victor V2 response. Join only responses and receipts that repeat all three methods plus the identical package, scope, non-scope, current role, current identity, currentness, and ceiling. The result is only structural eligibility for a separate lifecycle decision. Removing any method or binding introduces hidden algorithm glue or authority ambiguity.
evolution_profile: Expected evolution includes checker implementation, policy revision, new protected package classes, and external L2. The smallest extension boundary is the versioned level vocabulary plus level-specific producer contract; every revision remains a new frozen package or policy version.
premortem: Likely failure: a convenient checker or reused receipt silently follows changed bytes, guesses a digest algorithm, or broadens a role. Guardrails: three required const digest methods repeated by every evidence contract, explicit non-scope, method-negative fixtures, same-principal negative, post-freeze supersession, direct V2 requirement, and claim-ceiling checks.
frame_expiry_note: Re-run Design if Rondelli is no longer the proposed primary principal, Victor gains semantic authority, OAR hazard classes change, a third verifier topology is introduced, or external L2 becomes available.
navigation_guide: Start with owner-admission/PACKAGE-MANIFEST.json; inspect design/ROLE-ASSIGNMENTS.candidate.json and design/VERIFICATION-LEVELS.candidate.json; then inspect the separate Rondelli and Victor pending requests. Parent Balancer must reconcile before any protected route.

superseding_candidate_repair.trigger: Parent Balancer found that revision @1 carried a package_content_digest but declared no portable deterministic method for reproducing it.
superseding_candidate_repair.affected_invariant: Every acceptance-critical digest must declare an exact reproducible byte projection and canonicalization method.

revision_2_candidate_at_turn_2.claim_at_turn_2: superseding locally validated Design candidate only

superseding_candidate_repair.restricted_domain_exactness: All 12 paths and projected object keys are printable ASCII; all 12 digests are lowercase 64-character hexadecimal strings; the RFC 8785 projection contains no numbers or non-ASCII strings. Unicode code-point path order and RFC 8785 member order are therefore exact and independently reproducible for this domain.

superseding_candidate_repair_turn_3.trigger: Parent independent review found that revision @2 did not declare the manifest self-digest method and future owner-response and verification-receipt schemas did not repeat all digest-method bindings.
superseding_candidate_repair_turn_3.affected_invariant: Artifact, package-content, and manifest digest algorithms must be exact, self-contained, const-bound, and repeated by every future evidence contract.

current_candidate.claim: superseding locally validated Design candidate only

superseding_candidate_repair_turn_3.full_manifest_rfc8785_exactness: The full manifest contains only ASCII keys and strings plus one integer revision; it contains no floating-point values, booleans, nulls, control characters, or non-ASCII text. Python restricted-domain RFC 8785 serialization and independent jq sorted compact serialization with its LF removed produce identical UTF-8 bytes.
